cases.subject: Supply Chain Weekly: security and privacy summary of your account
cases.body:
SUPPLY CHAIN WEEKLY | Security and privacy summary

This message is generated by the account system twice per year and sent to all active accounts. It contains no editorial content and no offer. It describes the state of the security and privacy settings of your account on 15.01.2027.

Sign-in security: your account uses a password that was last changed on 14.01.2027. Two-step verification is switched off. You can switch it on in the Security section of your account page. Known devices: 3. The oldest known device was added on 02.03.2026.

Sessions: one active session on a laptop and one on a mobile phone. You can end all sessions in one step from the account page.

Privacy settings: the reading summary is switched on. The system keeps the details of opens and clicks for 12 months. Sharing of statistics with third parties is switched off, and the system never shares the address of your account with advertisers.

Data requests: no request for access, correction or deletion of data was made in the last 12 months. Requests can be sent through the form in the Data and privacy section.

Notifications: you receive account notices, delivery receipts and price alerts. Reminders and activity receipts are switched on.

Retention: after the closing of an account the system deletes the data within 30 days, except for the records that the law requires to keep.

If any of the settings above looks wrong, open the account page and change it. The system does not need a reply to this message. It was generated automatically, please do not reply to this address.

cases.body:
SUPPLY CHAIN WEEKLY | Yearly review of alerts

This is an automated review of the alerts and settings on your account. It was generated on 15.01.2027 by the subscription system. It holds no editorial content and no offer.

Active alerts: 3. The first alert watches the Baltic container rate index with a threshold of 1 480 points. The second watches the European road freight index with a threshold of 112 points. The third watches the diesel price index for Central Europe with a threshold of 1.45 euro per litre.

Triggered in the last 12 months: 5 alerts, the most recent on 12.01.2027. Alerts that never triggered: 1.

Settings: the weekly digest is sent on Fridays at 07:00. The delivery format is the full digest. Regions: Europe, Baltic Sea. Topics: freight rates, customs, warehousing, regulation.

The limit of alerts in the free plan is 5, and 2 places are free. When an alert triggers, the system sends one message and switches the alert off, as described in the terms of the service.

Saved articles: 3 active, with the oldest saved on 20.12.2026. Items that are not opened for 90 days are removed automatically.

If an alert or a setting is no longer needed, you can remove it on the account page. The system does not need a reply. It was generated automatically, please do not reply to this address.

cases.subject: Roczne podsumowanie rachunku firmowego za 2026
cases.body:
Aurum Bank | Podsumowanie roczne

Wiadomość została wygenerowana automatycznie 05.01.2027 i zawiera roczne podsumowanie rachunku firmowego PL00-TEST-4410 za rok 2026. Podsumowanie ma charakter informacyjny i nie jest dokumentem podatkowym.

Liczba operacji w roku: 3 842, w tym 1 906 obciążeń i 1 936 uznań.

Suma obciążeń: 17 482 910,30 PLN. Suma uznań: 17 540 212,40 PLN.

Saldo na początek roku: 240 380,15 PLN. Saldo na koniec roku: 297 682,25 PLN.

Opłaty bankowe w roku: 5 874,00 PLN, w tym opłaty za prowadzenie rachunku 1 068,00 PLN, za przelewy 3 232,00 PLN i za karty 240,00 PLN.

Odsetki od salda: 14 210,10 PLN brutto.

Przelewy zagraniczne: 74 operacje, w tym 41 w EUR, 17 w SEK i 16 w GBP.

Liczba użytkowników bankowości: 5. Zmiany uprawnień w roku: 3.

Operacje odrzucone przez bank: 12, głównie z powodu przekroczenia limitów jednorazowych lub błędnych numerów rachunku odbiorcy.

Szczegółowe wyciągi miesięczne są dostępne w bankowości internetowej, w zakładce Wyciągi, przez 24 miesiące. Podsumowanie wysyłamy raz w roku, w pierwszym tygodniu stycznia, do administratora rachunku i na adres powiadomień. Wartości liczbowe pochodzą z księgi rachunku według stanu na koniec dnia 31.12.2026. Prosimy nie odpowiadać na tę wiadomość.
